cohort.source_custody: known prior branch declarations plus parent reachable research SHA scans, unknown disconnected branches not proved
cohort.information: original public image/direction/mission, own selected public before-after, action/reward/terminal. No world coordinates, map, private inventory, external source-selected action or oracle.
cohort.cold_memory: within each family across all three seeds, per role independently; episode-local navigation pacing reset on authentic env.reset; never across roles/families
cohort.resource: same selected step caps, no full Go child CPU/memory parity; cross-language compute not yet science qualified

navigation_aware_control.type: conventional empirical source-selected public transition/reward model with rotation-neutral observed-novelty and bounded per-state action optimism; generic public-object affordance prior
navigation_aware_control.turn_neutral: turn-left and turn-right always receive zero intrinsic observation-change or novel-region credit, even if public SHA changes
navigation_aware_control.forward: no inference of physical motion; distinguish selected forward with changed public view from selected forward with unchanged public view
navigation_aware_control.last_forward_stall: After exact same public before/after on own selected forward, give one exploratory turn higher priority; never claim hidden collision or position
navigation_aware_control.public_generic_affordances: Object type5/6/7 directly in public front adds symmetric pickup (action3) exploratory prior; type4 door directly in front adds action5 exploratory prior; no mission target condition, key possession, reward shaping, scripted path, invented consequence, or privileged geometry.
navigation_aware_control.tie: sha256 exact raw original public context first byte modulo 7, fixed order
navigation_aware_control.checkpoint: canonical serialized selected empirical transition model, visitation and action effects plus ephemeral phase, exactly restorable; episode local phase reset on reset

measure.per_family_role: exact goal-positive episodes and actual selected target pickup effects, any target-visible public frames, target-front frames, selected pickup attempts and door opens, selected action0..6, prior public-change and forward-nochange, episode count
measure.navigation: compare turns percentage, source-selected forward actions, actual before/after public change of forward. Rotation-observation change not count locomotion
measure.comparator: retain both MG33-C original qualified controls, MG33 frontier, MG34 lookahead, unchanged MG36 model, unchanged natives; selected original public source only

require_all: candidate positive original terminal goals in >=2 unfamiliar pickup families
candidate >=1 positive original goal in UnlockPickup or BlockedUnlockPickup
candidate >=1 original exact selected target pickup effect
candidate total positive unfamiliar goal episodes strictly exceeds every listed comparator
candidate selected-turn fraction strictly below the original MG36 empirical control under the matched new original DEV seeds
dev_filter.always: DEV success does not establish strong state-of-the-art conventional baseline, native improvement, transfer or resource-matched science
